attachments.name: 20-1402 Amendment – Board Policy – BP 3312 Contracts and Delegation of Authority

enrichment.headline: Lets the Chief Business Officer sign vendor contracts up to $50,000 a year
enrichment.summary: This updates Board Policy 3312 so the Chief Business Officer can enter into contracts with a single vendor without a separate board vote, up to $50,000 in total in a fiscal year. It changes who has signing authority; it does not spend money by itself.

history.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
history.motion: A motion was made by HintonHodge, seconded by Gonzales, to Approve the General Consent Report. The motion carried by the following vote

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.text: Approval by the Board of Education of Amendment of Board Policy - Business and Noninstructional Operations - BP 3312 Contracts and Delegation of Authority, updating the Policy, if approved, to add the Chief Business Officer with delegated authority to enter into a Contract up to $50,000.00, in a Fiscal Year, cumulatively, with a vendor.
items.title: Amendment – Board Policy – BP 3312 Contracts and Delegation of Authority

attachments.name: 20-1397 Amendment No. 1, College and Career Access Pathways Act (CCAP) Agreement - AB 288 - District and Peralta Community College District
20-1397 Amendment No. 1, College and Career Access Pathways Act (CCAP) Agreement - AB 288 - District and Peralta (Signed) Community College District

enrichment.headline: Amends dual-enrollment agreement with Peralta Community College District for online learning
enrichment.summary: This changes the existing College and Career Access Pathways Act (CCAP) agreement under which Peralta Community College District teaches college pathway courses to Oakland high school students. The amendment allows online and distance learning because of the COVID-19 pandemic, names the district's representative, and covers increases in state funding for dual enrollment and special populations. All other terms stay the same.

history.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
history.motion: A motion was made by HintonHodge, seconded by Gonzales, to Approve the General Consent Report. The motion carried by the following vote

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.text: Adoption by the Board of Education of Amendment No. 1, College and Career Access Pathways Act (CCAP) Agreement* - AB 288 - by and between the District and Peralta Community College District, for the latter to provide AB 288 pathway courses, as defined, to high school students of the District, is amended as specified in paragraphs 2 through 4 of the Amendment, providing for online/distance learning due to COVID-19 pandemic, naming Lucia Moritz as School District’s Representative and providing for increases in State allocation for Dual Enrollment and all Special Populations as specified.  All other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain in full force and effect.
items.title: Amendment No. 1, College and Career Access Pathways Act (CCAP) Agreement - AB 288 - District and Peralta Community College District

enrichment.headline: Partners with Roses in Concrete charter school to bring it into Howard Elementary
enrichment.summary: This memorandum of understanding (MOU) sets up a partnership in which Roses in Concrete, a charter school, will operate at Howard Elementary School, a District school. It starts with a "Design Year" in School Year 2020-21. The text does not state a dollar amount.

attachments.name: 20-1399 Collective Bargaining Agreement Between the District and United Administrators of Oakland Schools (UAOS) (6/29/2020)
20-1399 Collective Bargaining Agreement Between the District and United Administrators of Oakland Schools (UAOS) (8/1/2020)

enrichment.headline: Approves 3-year contract with the school administrators' union, with 5% raises
enrichment.summary: This adopts a tentative agreement with United Administrators of Oakland Schools (UAOS), the union for certificated and classified administrators, covering July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2022. It includes a 5% ongoing raise starting July 1, 2020 for employees who are not retiring, a 5% raise effective January 1, 2020 for those who retire on or before June 30, 2020, and bonuses described in the agreement. The text gives no dollar totals.

history.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
history.motion: A motion was made by Yee, seconded by London, to Approve the General Consent Report. The motion carried by the following vote:

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Collective Bargaining Agreement Between the District and United Administrators of Oakland Schools (UAOS)
